what_happened: A docs job to amend decision D08 so the docs match the new read-only commit history access was rejected at final verification. The verifier found 3 of 5 acceptance criteria unmet: the grep for leftover "agents never see history" sentences, the docs-only diff scope, and the criterion that cargo test, clippy and fmt all pass. It raised two findings. The blocker: the D08 edit shifted docs/decisions.md by 3 lines, which broke the backtest doc-reference tests, because docs/decision-links.toml was not updated. The major: docs/design/athena-v0.md (line 473 and §4.1) still says the producer and verifier never see history. One check failed: the cargo test run, in `athena-cli --lib` and `athena-cli --test backtest`. The failed check is separate from the unmet criteria. The test failure matches the blocker and the third criterion. The docs-only scope criterion is listed as unmet, but no finding explains it.
cause: Docs hold line-number and text references to each other: decision-links.toml and the backtest tests pin positions in decisions.md, and design docs repeat the claim a decision makes. Nothing tells the producer about these dependents or checks them after an edit. The stale claim in athena-v0.md was found by no grep or cross-check before the verifier. The producer did not run the full test suite or sweep the docs for the old claim before handover. The reading treated "amend D08" as a single-place edit, not as a change that other files depend on. The rejection came after all spend.
prevention: Add a check that runs when a job edits docs/decisions.md. It fails if any decision's line range or anchor in docs/decision-links.toml no longer matches the file. It also fails if the repeated claim, found by searching docs/ for the old phrases the amended decision replaces, is still present unamended. Better still, make decision-links.toml key on decision ids rather than line numbers, so edits cannot shift it. Run the check in the producer's own loop and show its failures to the producer before handover.
proposed_request: Amend decision D08 in docs/decisions.md so it matches read-only commit history access, and add a pointer to D155. Keep every edit under docs/. Outcome: no sentence anywhere in docs/ (including docs/design/athena-v0.md line 473 and §4.1) says the producer or verifier never see history without being reworded or marked superseded by D155. After the edit, docs/decision-links.toml and any other doc references to decisions.md line positions must still resolve, so the backtest doc-reference tests pass. Before finishing, search docs/ for the old claim and run cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check; all must pass. Do not change files under crates/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows.
